subject: Post-call: Acme POC success criteria, timeline & access next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme POC success criteria, timeline & access next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment across product and security on what you want to validate. As promised, summary & next steps below to get the POC started.

POC objective / success criteria
- Validate inference economics and latency on your expected workload (target: p95 latency < 200ms for 512-token requests; target cost <= $X / 1k tokens).
- Functional validation: end-to-end integration with our API for prompt templates, streaming, and structured outputs.
- Reliability: no more than 2% error rate for typical traffic over a 48h window.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Start date: Mon Jun 16 (you confirmed readiness next week)
- Duration: 2 weeks, review 2025-06-30
- Deliverables: run 3 representative batch tests + 24h steady-state traffic window; shared perf dashboard and cost breakdown.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE) — overall POC owner; DevOps engineer: Dev Patel — access & infra provisioning; Support contact: Ben Carter.
- Acme: Alex Johnson — product lead; Priya Singh — security/compliance lead.

Immediate asks from your side
1) Confirm the two engineers who need SSO invites (name + work email).
2) Confirm IP ranges to allowlist (we'll need CIDR blocks) — we can also provide an IP allowlist test if you prefer.
3) Any procurement/PO timeline constraints.

What Redwood will do this week
- Dev Patel will provision a short-lived API key scoped for the POC, configure IP allowlist entries, and send SSO invites to the nominated users.
- Share MOP (method-of-play) doc and SSO setup guide (attaching stubs).

Attachments: poc-mop.pdf (stated test plan), sso-setup-guide.pdf (how to accept SSO invite)

Next step: if you confirm the engineers and IP ranges by EOD Thu (Jun 12), we can provision on Fri and start next Mon Jun 16.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme POC success criteria, timeline & access next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming success criteria and timeline look good. A few details from our side:

Engineers to invite (SSO):
- Sam Park <sam.park@acme-corp.com>
- Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-corp.com>

IP ranges (egress from our test infra) to allowlist:
- 18.205.0.0/16
- 54.240.0.0/12

Procurement: no PO until after POC. We may need a short NDA addendum — Priya, can you confirm?

Also, we'll need an API key with rate limits suitable for a 2-worker steady-state test (approx 50 rps aggregate) and an S3-compatible test dataset endpoint; can you confirm those will be available?

Thanks — we can confirm everything by EOD Thu.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme-corp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Acme POC success criteria, timeline & access next steps

Folks — forwarding Acme's confirmation. Action items for infra:
- Provision a POC-scoped API key (short-lived, 30d) with a per-minute limit that supports ~50 rps for the test window. Please mask key when sending; include how to rotate.
- Configure IP allowlist for: 18.205.0.0/16, 54.240.0.0/12.
- Send SSO invites to sam.park@acme-corp.com and lina.gomez@acme-corp.com (Redwood SSO via SAML, acme uses Okta).
- Confirm whether we can expose an S3-compatible signed URL endpoint for their test dataset (or advise if they should push to our staging bucket).

Target: complete provisioning by Fri Jun 13 so we can start Mon Jun 16. Ben — can you be on standby for any escalation?

Thanks — M.
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme POC success criteria, timeline & access next steps

Hi team — provisioning complete. Details below and notes on usage & rotation: 

1) API key (POC scoped)
- Key ID: poc-acme-2025
- Key token (masked in email): ri_api_key_poc_acme_live_****
- Scope: inference:generate, inference:stream, embeddings:read
- Rate limits applied: burst 200 r/s, sustained 50 r/s (per your request)
- Validity: 30 days (expires 2025-07-12); can be rotated via Console > API Keys or call our rotation endpoint.

2) IP allowlist
- Added CIDRs: 18.205.0.0/16, 54.240.0.0/12 to Acme POC profile; change will take effect immediately. If you see blocked requests, reply with timestamp and we'll debug.

3) SSO invites
- Invites sent to: sam.park@acme-corp.com, lina.gomez@acme-corp.com (Redwood SAML/Okta). They should receive an email with a magic link; acceptance instructions attached (sso-setup-guide.pdf).

4) Data access for tests
- We can provide a signed S3-compatible upload URL for a staging bucket. If you prefer to push to your bucket and share signed URLs, that's fine — either works. Let me know which you prefer and I'll generate the URLs.

Attachments: [attachment: sso-setup-guide.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)], [attachment: poc-mop.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)]

Operational notes:
- API key rotation: we recommend rotating after the POC; I'll create a replacement key and update you before expiration.
- Monitoring: I created a Grafana dashboard (link below) that will be shared with Alex/Priya; we'll also push traces to your Sentry if you provide a project key.

Links:
- POC dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc-acme-2025
- Rotation docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/api-keys#rotation

If anything looks off, ping me and I can remediate quickly.

—Dev
Dev Patel
SRE | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Thanks Dev / Marissa — got the invites and API key mask. Sam & Lina have accepted SSO and will run the onboarding tests this afternoon. We'll reply with any blocked IP traces if we hit issues.

Confirming next steps from Acme:
- Sam/Lina to run integration and 24h steady-state traffic window starting Mon Jun 16.
- Alex to share preliminary perf samples by Tue Jun 17; then sync with Marissa/Ben on Thu Jun 19.

Priya — we still need the NDA addendum; can you advise on timing?

—Alex
